uroboros_routes.title: Renew a TLS certificate on a reverse proxy without downtime
preconditions: you know which proxy serves the name
the DNS name resolves to that proxy
steps: read the current certificate expiry with openssl s_client
issue the new certificate through the existing ACME client
test the proxy configuration before reloading
reload the proxy, do not restart it
postchecks: openssl s_client shows the new expiry date
the health endpoint answers over HTTPS
uroboros_routes.rollback: restore the previous certificate files from the backup and reload the proxy

uroboros_routes.title: Prove a database backup restores, on a scratch instance
preconditions: a scratch instance that is not production
steps: pick the newest backup and record its checksum
restore it into the scratch instance
run row counts on the key tables and compare with the source
postchecks: the row counts match within the backup window

uroboros_routes.title: Open a pull request to Integrity that passes the public surface CI
steps: git add, then .github/scripts/component_catalog.py --write, then update_manifest.py again
run public_surface_check.py on a git checkout-index export, not on a worktree
run the root suite with every components/*/src on PYTHONPATH
postchecks: the Public surface safety workflow is green on Linux and Windows
